qa_pair.question: How many total check-ins do I have on my Foursquare account?
What is the venue name and city of my very first check-in (oldest)?
In calendar year 2024, how many check-ins did I make? (UTC year boundaries: 1704067200 to 1735689599 inclusive.)
What is the single venue I have checked in to the most times across my entire history? Return the venue name only.
Of my 100 most recent check-ins, what is the most common short category name (e.g. "Coffee Shop", "Airport")?
How many distinct cities appear across my 200 most recent check-ins?
What is the venue ID of my most recent airport check-in? (Look at the categories array for "Airport".)
Among my 50 most recent check-ins, what is the highest single-check-in score (points awarded by Foursquare)?
What city does my Foursquare profile list as my home city?
Of my 100 most recent check-ins, how many included a non-empty "shout" (text comment from me)?
